overrides.reason: Next.js 16.2.10 resolves postcss 8.4.31, which is affected by GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93. The patched 8.5.19 release is already exercised by this workspace's Vite graph and remains within the same major API line.
overrides.removalCondition: Remove this override once the pinned Next.js release resolves postcss 8.5.10 or newer itself, then rerun the registry audit, production build, and CSS/browser verification.

overrides.reason: The current web application does not use next/image or runtime image optimization, so the native sharp and libvips graph is unnecessary product code and distribution surface. A never-typed ambient sentinel satisfies Next.js's upstream type-only reference, while ESLint forbids product imports.
overrides.removalCondition: Remove this override and the type-only sentinel before enabling Next.js image optimization or any feature that requires sharp, then review the native binary and LGPL obligations.
